preToolUse.bash: if [ -e .git ] && [ -f .github/hooks/sdlc-tdd-guard.sh ]; then cat | sh .github/hooks/sdlc-tdd-guard.sh pre-write; fi

postToolUse.bash: if [ -e .git ] && [ -f .github/hooks/sdlc-tdd-guard.sh ]; then cat | sh .github/hooks/sdlc-tdd-guard.sh observe-test; fi

agentStop.bash: if [ -e .git ] && [ -f .github/hooks/sdlc-tdd-guard.sh ]; then cat | sh .github/hooks/sdlc-tdd-guard.sh stop-check; elif grep -q 'stop_hook_active.: *true'; then :; else echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"SDLC TDD guard did not run: .github/hooks/sdlc-tdd-guard.sh is missing, so no write in this session was guarded. Tell the owner."}'; fi
